rationale: The plan matches the reference design: batch enters as a balanced covariate in ~ batch + condition with control set explicitly as reference, counts are never adjusted or pre-normalized before the model, and DESeq2 Wald plus a limma-voom/TMM concordance check fit the n=6-per-arm structure. QC is thorough and design-specific: library sizes, detection, VST PCA colored by condition and shaped by batch with per-PC association statistics, correlation heatmap, condition x batch cross-tabulation, and a named-outlier policy with no silent dropping. The low-count filter (>=10 counts in >=6 samples, tied to the smaller arm) is minimal and justified, though slightly on the conventional side of arbitrary; BH at alpha 0.05 with apeglm/ashr shrinkage for ranking, NA-padj accounting, and a p-value histogram calibration check are all stated, with thresholds applied in the test rather than post hoc. Enrichment uses the full ranked list with the Wald statistic as the stated metric, human hallmark and GO BP collections with size window 15-500, tested genes as the ORA universe, and redundancy collapsing; only explicit collection versioning is missing. Reporting names methods, packages, design, thresholds, gene counts tested and significant, and the power/df caveats of a 12-sample design.
